# See https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/wiki/Configuration-Examples:-patterns

# gimpfont.c unicode table
\* U\+[0-9A-F]{4}(?: [A-Z]+)+

# Localizable text with accelerators
(?<![$])\b[A-Za-z][a-z]*_[a-z]+(?![}(])(?=\b[^"]*(?:"(?:$|\)(?![.])))|</attribute>)

[23]d(?=[a-z]{4})

# ChangeLog
^(?:(?:(?:Sun|Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat) )?(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec) [ \d]\d (?:\d\d:){2}\d\d (?:[A-Z]{3,} )?\d{4}|\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d) .* (?:<.*>|\(.*\))

# file-icns-data.c
^\s*\{"[^"]{3,5}"(?:,\s*\d+)+,(?: "[^"]{4}"|)

# commits
commit (?!(?:\d+|[a-z]+)\b)[0-9a-f]{3,}\b

# intentional string
(?:g_str_has_prefix|strcpy)\s*\([^,]+, ".*?"

# script-fu-compat.scm
\([a-e]{5}\)

# PSD 4 byte things
PSD_[A-Z_\d]+\s+".{4}"

# script 4 byte things
^      ".{4}"

# compare 4 byte things
".{4}", 4

# Color code
\[0K(?=[A-Za-z])

(?<=[a-z])i18n
GNU(?=[a-z])

# Automatically suggested patterns

# hit-count: 16561 file-count: 2330
# #includes
^\s*#include\s*(?:<.*?>|".*?")

# hit-count: 8079 file-count: 1897
# libraries
(?:\b|_)(?i)lib(?:re(?=office)|)(?!era[lt]|ero|erty|rar(?:i(?:an|es)|y))(?=[a-z])

# hit-count: 4634 file-count: 3390
# copyright
Copyright (?:\([Cc]\)|)(?:[-\d, ]|and)+(?:(?:[- ][A-Z][a-z]+){2,},?)+

# hit-count: 815 file-count: 102
# hex digits including css/html color classes:
(?:[\\0][xX]|\\u\{?|[uU]\+|#x?|%23|&H)[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*?[a-fA-FgGrR]{2,}[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*(?:[uUlL]{0,3}|[iu]\d+)\b

# hit-count: 781 file-count: 56
# version suffix <word>v#
(?:(?<=[A-Z]{2})V|(?<=[a-z]{2}|[A-Z]{2})v)\d+(?:\b|(?=[a-zA-Z_]))

# hit-count: 629 file-count: 261
# https/http/file urls
(?:\b(?:https?|ftp|file)://)[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%?=~_|!:,.;]+[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%=~_|]

^\s+\*\s+-(?=[A-Z][a-z])

# hit-count: 431 file-count: 71
# Compiler flags (Unix, Java/Scala)
# Use if you have things like `-Pdocker` and want to treat them as `docker`
(?:^|[\t ,>"'`=(#])-(?:(?:J-|)(?:D(?!est)|P(?!ass|ath|eter)|[WXY])|l(?!ength|ib|ist)|L|f(?!ilter|ramework))(?=[A-Z]{2,}|[A-Z][a-z]|[a-z]{2,})

# hit-count: 380 file-count: 27
# python
\b(?i)py(?!gments|gmy|lon|ramid|ro|th)(?=[a-z]{2,})

# IServiceProvider / isAThing

# hit-count: 104 file-count: 6
# Intel intrinsics
_mm\d*_(?!dd)\w+

# hit-count: 98 file-count: 16
# C network byte conversions
(?:\d|\bh)to(?!ken)(?=[a-z])|to(?=[adhiklpun]\()

# hit-count: 72 file-count: 19
# in check-spelling@v0.0.22+, printf markers aren't automatically consumed
# printf markers
(?<!\\)\\(?:zn(?!ew)|zr(?!eturn)|t(?![wxy]))(?=[a-z]{2,})

# hit-count: 55 file-count: 17
# This does not cover multiline strings, if your repository has them,
# you'll want to remove the `(?=.*?")` suffix.
# The `(?=.*?")` suffix should limit the false positives rate
# printf
%(?:(?:(?:hh?|ll?|[jzt])?[diuoxn]|l?[cs]|L?[fega]|p)(?=[a-z]{2,}))(?!%)(?=[_a-zA-Z]+(?!%)\b)(?=.*?['"])

# hit-count: 54 file-count: 16
# hex runs
\b[0-9a-fA-F]{16,}\b

# hit-count: 33 file-count: 9
# Repeated letters
\b([a-z])\g{-1}{2,}\b

# hit-count: 32 file-count: 9
# File extensions
\*\.[+\w]+,

# hit-count: 27 file-count: 13
# Python string prefix / binary prefix
# Note that there's a high false positive rate, remove the `?=` and search for the regex to see if the matches seem like reasonable strings
(?<!['"])\b(?:B|BR|Br|F|FR|Fr|R|RB|RF|Rb|Rf|U|UR|Ur|b|bR|br|f|fR|fr|r|rB|rF|rb|rf|u|uR|ur)['"](?=[A-Z]{3,}|[A-Z][a-z]{2,}|[a-z]{3,})

# hit-count: 24 file-count: 17
# imports
^import\s+(?:(?:static|type)\s+|)(?:[\w.]|\{\s*\w*?(?:,\s*(?:\w*|\*))+\s*\})+

# hit-count: 17 file-count: 3
# C# includes
^\s*using [^;]+;

# hit-count: 15 file-count: 11
# Markdown anchor links
\(#\S*?[a-zA-Z]\S*?\)

# hit-count: 13 file-count: 3
# latex (check-spelling >= 0.0.22)
\\\w{2,}\{

# hit-count: 11 file-count: 8
# container images
image: [-\w./:@]+

# hit-count: 11 file-count: 4
# perl regex test
[!=]~ (?:/.*/|m\{.*?\}|m<.*?>|m([|!/@#,;']).*?\g{-1})

# hit-count: 10 file-count: 5
# ANSI color codes
(?:\\(?:u00|x)1[Bb]|\\03[1-7]|\x1b|\\u\{1[Bb]\})\[\d+(?:;\d+)*m

# hit-count: 6 file-count: 3
# css url wrappings
\burl\([^)]+\)

# hit-count: 4 file-count: 3
# Windows Resources with accelerators
\b[A-Z]&[a-z]+\b(?!;)

# hit-count: 3 file-count: 3
# perl run
perl(?:\s+-[a-zA-Z]\w*)+

# hit-count: 3 file-count: 2
# tar arguments
\b(?:\\n|)g?tar(?:\.exe|)(?:(?:\s+--[-a-zA-Z]+|\s+-[a-zA-Z]+|\s[ABGJMOPRSUWZacdfh-pr-xz]+\b)(?:=[^ ]*|))+

# hit-count: 3 file-count: 1
# highlighted letters
\[[A-Z]\][a-z]+

# hit-count: 2 file-count: 1
# sed regular expressions
sed 's/(?:[^/]*?[a-zA-Z]{3,}[^/]*?/){2}

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# uuid:
\b[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-){3}[0-9a-fA-F]{12}\b

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# regex choice
\(\?:[^)]+\|[^)]+\)

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# French
# This corpus only had capital letters, but you probably want lowercase ones as well.
\b[LN]'+[a-z]{2,}\b

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# patch hunk comments
^@@ -\d+(?:,\d+|) \+\d+(?:,\d+|) @@ .*

# Questionably acceptable forms of `in to`
# Personally, I prefer `log into`, but people object
# https://www.tprteaching.com/log-into-log-in-to-login/
\b(?:(?:[Ll]og(?:g(?=[a-z])|)|[Ss]ign)(?:ed|ing)?) in to\b

# to opt in
\bto opt in\b

# pass(ed|ing) in
\bpass(?:ed|ing) in\b

# acceptable duplicates
# ls directory listings
[-bcdlpsw](?:[-r][-w][-SsTtx]){3}[\.+*]?\s+\d+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+[.\d]+(?:[KMGT]|)\s+
# mount
\bmount\s+-t\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\b
# C types and repeated CSS values
\s(auto|buffalo|center|div|inherit|long|LONG|none|normal|solid|thin|transparent|very)(?:\s\g{-1})+\s
# C enum and struct
\b(?:enum|struct)\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\b
# go templates
\s(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\s+\`(?:graphql|inject|json|yaml):
# doxygen / javadoc / .net
(?:[\\@](?:brief|defgroup|groupname|link|t?param|return|retval)|(?:public|private|\[Parameter(?:\(.+\)|)\])(?:\s+(?:static|override|readonly|required|virtual))*)(?:\s+\{\w+\}|)\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\s

# macOS file path
(?:Contents\W+|(?!iOS)/)MacOS\b

# Python package registry has incorrect spelling for macOS / Mac OS X
"Operating System :: MacOS :: MacOS X"

# "company" in Germany
\bGmbH\b

# IntelliJ
\bIntelliJ\b

# Commit message -- Signed-off-by and friends
^\s*(?:(?:Based-on-patch|Co-authored|Helped|Mentored|Reported|Reviewed|Signed-off)-by|Thanks-to): (?:[^<]*<[^>]*>|[^<]*)\s*$

# Autogenerated revert commit message
^This reverts commit [0-9a-f]{40}\.$

# ignore long runs of a single character:
\b([A-Za-z])\g{-1}{3,}\b
